hikes.name: Lower Macleay to Pittock Mansion
hikes.blurb: Forest Park's best short hike: up Balch Creek past the old stone 'Witch's Castle' to a mansion lawn facing Mt Hood.

hikes.name: Marquam Trail to Council Crest
hikes.blurb: Through a ravine forest in the West Hills to Portland's highest point and a view of five volcanoes.

hikes.name: Powell Butte
hikes.blurb: An old volcano in east Portland, meadows and orchards on top with Mt Hood straight ahead.

hikes.name: Mount Scott
hikes.blurb: From SE Fuller Rd Park & Ride, a 6.4-mile round trip to the top of Mount Scott (1,082 ft), with about 1,050 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Coffee Creek Falls
hikes.blurb: From Emmanuel Presbyterian Church, a 9.4-mile round trip to Coffee Creek Falls, with about 1,400 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Singer Falls
hikes.blurb: From Camassia parking, a 2.4-mile round trip to Singer Falls, with about 450 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Bonnie Falls
hikes.blurb: From Ruley, a 5.1-mile round trip to Bonnie Falls, with about 400 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Tumble Creek Falls
hikes.blurb: From First Presbyterian Church, a 3.0-mile round trip to Tumble Creek Falls, with about 350 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Jane Martin Waterfall
hikes.blurb: From North Parking, a 1.1-mile round trip to Jane Martin Waterfall.
